scope: Reproduction GPU primary comparison and PCGrad on/off only. Does not cover original CPU A0-A7 or lambda sensitivity.
limitations: Checkpoints, training histories, raw inputs and split NPZ files were not supplied; no model execution/reload performed. PCGrad metadata and predictions reconcile with public Macro-F1 scores; full PCGrad metadata hashes are not independently anchored to a GitHub manifest here.
auc_definition: One-vs-rest ROC-AUC computed per class per seed with tie half-credit, then unweighted class mean; statistics are mean and sample SD across ten seeds.
ap_definition: Non-interpolated AP with grouped thresholds, not trapezoidal PR-AUC.
